name: peaking-mf-2
description: Focus peaking whenever the focus mode in use is MF (prm 0xC021 = 1), with any lens and without the magnified view; the focus-ring trigger (MF Assist) as before. T_R's test of R goes through T_MF in segment 1 (version 1 had it in segment 2, which is not in RAM at the first live-view refresh of a cold start). experiments/2026-11-21-peaking-mf/NOTES.md, experiments/2026-11-24-slow-boot/NOTES.md section 8.

ops._note: new code, segment 1: T_MF (the test of R, the focus mode, GUI state 0x5101: no lines) (61 B)
new code, segment 2: T_GS (keeps the GUI state) (12 B)
the GUI state setter's hook (log-menu-3): `jmp T_GUI` -> `jmp T_GS`, which jumps on to T_GUI
